title: Yadda gyare-gyaren kwayoyin halitta ke aiki da gaske
course_title: Halittar Halittar Halitta da Ilimin Halittu na Zamani

say: Yadda gyare-gyaren kwayoyin halitta ke aiki da gaske.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don samfurin daya na Halittun Halittu da aka Gyara da Kimiyyar Halittu na Zamani.

Kafin kowane muhawara game da GMOs yana da ma'ana, kuna buƙatar kimiyya. A cikin wannan bidiyon za ku ga abin da kwayoyin halitta suke yi, da kuma yadda masana kimiyya ke motsa kwayar halitta daya zuwa amfanin gona.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
panel.heading: Kimiyya ta farko, sannan muhawara
items: Abin da DNA, kwayoyin halitta da sunadarai suke yi
Yadda ake matsar da kwayar halitta daya zuwa amfanin gona
Waɗanne halaye amfanin gona na GM ke ɗauka
Yadda ake warware da'awar da kuka ji

say: Sa'an nan za ku koyi irin halayen amfanin gona na GM da gaske suke ɗauka, da kuma yadda za ku warware da'awar da kuka ji don ku san irin shaidar da kowane ɗayan yake bukata.

say: Kowane abu mai rai, tun daga shukar saniya zuwa yisti a cikin burodin ku, yana ɗauke da umarni da aka rubuta cikin DNA. DNA tana amfani da haruffan sinadarai guda huɗu, A, T, G da C. Tsarin su shine saƙo.

panel.heading: Daga DNA zuwa yanayin da zaku iya gani
items: DNA: haruffa hudu, A, T, G da C
Hali: abin da kuke gani a cikin shuka

say: Tsawon DNA wanda ke ɗaukar umarnin aiki ɗaya shine kwayar halitta.

panel.heading: Daga DNA zuwa yanayin da zaku iya gani
items: DNA: haruffa hudu, A, T, G da C
Hali: abin da kuke gani a cikin shuka

say: Yawancin kwayoyin halitta sune girke-girke na sunadaran. Sunadaran suna yin aikin a cikin tantanin halitta.

panel.heading: Daga DNA zuwa yanayin da zaku iya gani
items: DNA: haruffa hudu, A, T, G da C
Hali: abin da kuke gani a cikin shuka

say: Launin hatsin masara, ko martanin shuka ga fari, ya fito ne daga sunadaran da ke aiki da muhalli. Canza haruffa, kuma zaku iya canza yanayin.

say: Ilimin halittu kawai yana nufin amfani da abubuwa masu rai don kera kayayyaki. Ta wannan ma'ana, matan Najeriya sun yi ta tun a tsararraki, suna fermenting ogi da zabar iri mafi kyau.

panel.heading: Na gargajiya ko na zamani?
left: Zaɓi mafi kyawun iri don sake dasa
Babu canji kai tsaye zuwa DNA
right: DNA ya canza a cikin dakin gwaje-gwaje
Insulin da GM microbes ke yi
Kayan amfanin gona na Bt masu jure wa kwari

say: Ilimin halittu na zamani yana aiki kai tsaye akan DNA a cikin dakin gwaje-gwaje. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta bayyana GMO ta hanyar: DNA ta canza ta hanyar da ba ta faruwa ta dabi'a ta hanyar jima'i.
Don haka lokacin da tsire-tsire biyu suka haye a cikin gona, wannan ba GMO ba ne. Kuma matasan ba GMO ba ne, saboda ba a shigar da kwayoyin halitta ba.

Kayan amfanin gona na Bt masu jure wa kwari

say: Mafi sanannun misali a Afirka shine Bt. Bakteriyar ƙasa Bacillus thuringiensis tana yin sunadarin Cry, wanda ke kashe ƴan ƙunƙun gungun tsutsa da ke cinye su. Alal misali, GM cowpea yana ɗauke da kwayar halitta wanda ke tsayayya da Maruca pod borer.

panel.heading: Yadda ake yin amfanin gona na GM

say: Masana kimiyya sun haɗu da kwayar halitta zuwa mai tallata, mai kunnawa, da kuma kwayar halitta mai alamar da ke taimakawa gano ƙwayoyin da suka ɗauke shi. Wannan kunshin shine ginawa.

panel.heading: Yadda ake yin amfanin gona na GM

say: Suna isar da shi tare da Agrobacterium, ƙwayoyin cuta na ƙasa wanda ta dabi'a ke canza DNA zuwa tsire-tsire, ko tare da bindigar kwayoyin halitta.

panel.heading: Yadda ake yin amfanin gona na GM

say: Kowane shigarwa yana ƙasa a wuri ɗaya, wanda ake kira taron. Masu haɓakawa suna kwatanta abubuwa da yawa kuma suna kiyaye mafi kyau. Masu gudanarwa sun amince da wani abu mai suna, kamar Event 245F.

panel.heading: Yadda ake yin amfanin gona na GM

say: A ƙarshe masu kiwo sun haye yanayin zuwa manoma iri-iri na gida kamar. Wannan yana ɗaukar shekaru.
Tsari ya wuce hannu zuwa hannu azaman sabon nau'in GM na iya zama mara yarda ko na karya. Dasa kayan GM da ba a yarda da su ya saba wa doka inda akwai dokokin kare lafiyar halittu.

panel.heading: Yadda ake yin amfanin gona na GM
panel.rule: Kada a taɓa shuka iri wanda ba a san asalinsa ba. Sayi ingantaccen iri.

say: Misali, ƙungiya tana son GM cowpea aƙalla kashi 95 cikin ɗari ɗaya da iri-iri na gida. Giciye na farko yana ba da DNA na gida kashi 50.

panel.heading: Komawa zuwa nau'in gida
items: Giciye na farko: 50 bisa dari DNA na gida
Backcross 4: 96.875 bisa dari, burin ya cika

say: Kowannen baya yana raba abin da ya rage daga iyayen GM. 75, sannan 87.5, sannan 93.75. Har yanzu kasa da 95.

panel.heading: Komawa zuwa nau'in gida
items: Giciye na farko: 50 bisa dari DNA na gida
Backcross 4: 96.875 bisa dari, burin ya cika

say: Na hudu backcross yana bada kusan kashi 96.9. Tare da ƙarni na saniya guda ɗaya a kakar, wannan shine dalili ɗaya da nau'in GM ke ɗaukar shekaru.

say: Halayen GM sun faɗi cikin manyan ƙungiyoyi biyar. A Najeriya, hukumar ta fitar da sanarwa game da noman nono mai jure wa kwari da masara TELA.
Amma wani hali yana magance matsala mai suna. Bt saniya har yanzu tana buƙatar ciyawa da bushewa da kyau. Koyaushe tambaya: wane amfanin gona, wane hali, wace taron, kuma wace ƙasa?
Yawancin rudani yana zuwa ne daga haɗa nau'ikan tambaya. Kowa yana bukatar shaidarsa.

Misali, Halima a Kano ta samu takardar murya daga wata kawu. Ta rubuta kowace da'awar kuma ta sami da'awar 4, nau'ikan nau'ikan 4, da majiyoyin 0 masu suna. Da'awar doka ta iya bincika ranar a gidan yanar gizon NBMA.

panel.heading: Iri huɗu na da'awar GMO
items: Amincin abinci: yana da lafiya a ci?
Muhalli: kwari, ciyawa, tsire-tsire na daji
Tattalin Arziki: farashi, yawan amfanin ƙasa, sarrafa iri

say: Don tunawa. Halittar halittu shine girke-girke. Ana bayyana GMO ta hanyar. Amincewa suna suna takamaiman taron. Kada a taɓa shuka iri wanda ba a san asalinsa ba. Kuma a warware kowace da'awa da nau'inta.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Halittar kwayoyin halitta girke-girke ne, yawanci ga furotin
Ana bayyana GMO ta yadda aka canza DNA
Masu gudanarwa sun amince da wani taron mai suna
Kada a taɓa shuka iri wanda ba a san asalinsa ba

say: Ayyukanku: tsara abinci da magunguna a cikin kicin ɗinku, zana tafiyar iri na GM, kuma fara rajistar da'awar tare da aƙalla da'awar guda shida, gami da wasu masu goyon bayan GMOs.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Jera fasahar kere-kere a cikin girkin ku
